author: Spartemex
body: Well, today is my one year anniversary with Avicus. Basically, I just wanted to say thank you to the community, and the staff for making this a server a really great one. It was a pIace for me to put my roots down in Minecraft, and really become a part of the community. Really, the reason I want to be staff is so that I can give back, repay all of you for this amazing network, and so that I can help Avicus be even more stunning as a community. I think for the past month, I haven't joined a single server except for Avicus, and its all because of you guys... Thank you :)
